The issuer shows solid liquidity with a current ratio of 2.31 and a substantial equity cushion of $5,711M (total assets of $18,687M against total liabilities of $13,001M), supported by a very strong historical base of retained earnings ($12,770M). However, the company is currently unprofitable, posting a net loss of $892M and an operating loss of $287M on $10,477M of revenue. This combination of strong balance sheet metrics but temporary high-volume profitability pressure is characteristic of a mid-to-lower investment-grade credit profile.

DECISION: BBB-
